rationale: The assistant ran a sensible short sequence (pump noise, impeller feel, check for foreign object) with unplug instructions and ended with an appropriate engineer referral, so it was safe and not fabricated. However it never engaged with 'FD 9409' (a production code, not a model) nor asked for the E-Nr, ignored the volunteered E18 code entirely, and skipped the drain hose/sump-hose possibility, then answered 'Yes, the symptoms point to a faulty drain pump' when the ground truth says pump failure versus sump blockage remains genuinely uncertain. No part number or compatibility was claimed, but the homeowner leaves without knowing his model or that the pump is only one of two live causes.
